text: The People's Party is equally a beneficiary of this system; the PPP's mere support for the government on national interests is a failed attempt to show that it is not with them in the government's controversial decisions. They will not leave this system, Shahzad Iqbal

text: Under Article 259, awards are given based on outstanding performance. Before 2018, awards were given to those within the top 100, but from Imran Khan's era, the looting and plundering began, and now this tradition has reached over 300 awards—Fakhar Durani@FrehmanD
